dedup: each finding is fingerprinted; a fingerprint already acted on or claimed is dropped before the call, so a tick with nothing new makes no call; the attempt count is written per fingerprint before the call (a failed write means no call) and a fingerprint at STAFF_MAX_ATTEMPTS is recorded failed with no call; AGENT_CALL_FP is the sorted fingerprint set, so the same batch is the same call key
note: BH-5561: the generic staff heartbeat, at most one model turn per agent tick and only for new findings (bin/staff.sh tick <agent>, cron/lanes/729-staff.cron). Capped per call by AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_STAFF_TICK=STAFF_LLM_MAX_USD (lanes.d staff, default 0.60). The model is model_routes stage.staff-tick (one route for every agent; the agent is STAFF_AGENT); no route is no call. Off: STAFF_ENABLED=0, flags/staff-off-all, flags/staff-off-<agent>.
